_說明: 片尾主題曲的逐句歌詞。t 是那一句開始的秒數（Whisper 逐字時間與 Gemini 聽寫交叉定的，逐句、不是逐字）。en 是照成品聽寫的英文；zh 是中文歌詞版（獨立作詞，歌裡沒有唱）。site/build_mv.py 讀這份產生 docs/theme.html 與 docs/music/theme.lrc。

lines.en: Tucked away inside a tiny bar
lines.zh: 巷子裡　躲著一間小酒吧

lines.en: Seven wooden stools against the dark
lines.zh: 七張高腳椅　排在暗暗的燈下

lines.en: Rain was falling in the narrow street
lines.zh: 那一晚　窄巷裡下著雨

lines.en: Whispered through the glass so soft and sweet
lines.zh: 雨隔著玻璃　像在輕聲細語

lines.en: I pour it slow, there is saffron in my glass
lines.zh: 我慢慢地倒　杯子裡有番紅花

lines.en: The sunset glows, memories that cannot pass
lines.zh: 晚霞亮起來　忘不掉妳說的話

lines.en: Hibiscus red is at the base
lines.zh: 洛神的紅　沉在杯底

lines.en: Recalling every line of your face
lines.zh: 想起妳的臉　一點都沒忘記

lines.en: She wrote everything by her own hand
lines.zh: 每一杯　妳都親手寫下來

lines.en: Flavors that her tongue could not command
lines.zh: 酒的味道　妳舌頭嚐不出來

lines.en: Take a little sip, is it sweet?
lines.zh: 喝一小口　妳問我甜嗎

lines.en: Asking me each time we would meet
lines.zh: 每一次見面　妳都問這句話

lines.en: I pour it slow, there is saffron in my glass
lines.zh: 我慢慢地倒　杯子裡有番紅花

lines.en: The sunset glows, memories that cannot pass
lines.zh: 晚霞亮起來　忘不掉妳說的話

lines.en: A layer of pink right on top
lines.zh: 最上面　浮著一層粉紅

lines.en: Hoping that this moment won't stop
lines.zh: 真希望時間　停在這一分鐘

lines.en: She told me always remember to eat
lines.zh: 妳跟我說　記得吃飯

lines.en: So I keep living on my own two feet
lines.zh: 所以我一個人　好好過每一天

lines.en: Stings for a moment when it hits my tongue
lines.zh: 碰到舌頭　先刺了一下

lines.en: But then it is sweet, just like when we were young
lines.zh: 然後就甜了　像剛認識妳那年

lines.en: It is still sweet, I whisper to you
lines.zh: 還是甜的　我小聲跟妳說

lines.en: As dusk paints the room in a dark shade of blue
lines.zh: 天快黑了　店裡一片深藍色

lines.en: The bar is still open, the light is still on
lines.zh: 店還開著　燈也還亮著

lines.en: I'm tender and grateful, though you are now gone
lines.zh: 妳不在了　我的心柔軟　也感激著
